description: This PHP script manages the display and handling of subpanels within the SuiteCRM system, including fetching subpanel definitions, initializing subpanel objects, and rendering the subpanel interface. It also includes security checks for entry point validation and input validation for required parameters.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the rendering and behavior of a subpanel within the SuiteCRM interface.

classes.name: SubPanelDefinitions
classes.description: Class that loads and manages definitions of available subpanels for a given module.

classes.name: jsAlerts
classes.description: Class handling JavaScript alert scripts for client-side notifications.

methods.name: load_subpanel
methods.description: Loads the subpanel configuration for a specific subpanel name, returning its definition.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file used for rendering the subpanel.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the subpanel's action buttons.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the subpanel content, optionally just the count if 'countOnly' is specified.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for alert dialogs, used for client notifications.
